# One build-time registration feeds both MLIR-free contracts and compiler-only
# terminal implementations. Runtime-only SDK builds never link the emitters.
set(extension_modules SpacemitIME1)
set(registry "")
set(contract_sources "")
set(emission_sources "")
foreach(module IN LISTS extension_modules)
  if(NOT module MATCHES "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Invalid RISC-V extension module: ${module}")
  endif()
  foreach(part Contracts Emission)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${module}/${part}.cpp")
      message(FATAL_ERROR "RISC-V extension ${module} needs ${part}.cpp")
    endif()
  endforeach()
  list(APPEND contract_sources "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${module}/Contracts.cpp")
  list(APPEND emission_sources "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${module}/Emission.cpp")
  string(APPEND registry "WEFT_RISCV_EXTENSION(${module})\n")
endforeach()
file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/WeftRISCVExtensionRegistry.inc"
     CONTENT "${registry}" @ONLY)
set(WEFT_RISCV_EXTENSION_CONTRACT_SOURCES "${contract_sources}" PARENT_SCOPE)
set(WEFT_RISCV_EXTENSION_EMISSION_SOURCES "${emission_sources}" PARENT_SCOPE)
set(WEFT_RISCV_EXTENSION_REGISTRY_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}" PARENT_SCOPE)
